message.content:
A cell that contains more than one nucleus is called a **multinucleated** (or **polynucleated**) cell.  
Examples include:

| Cell type | Typical function | Where it’s found |
|-----------|------------------|------------------|
| **Osteoclast** | Bone resorption | Bone tissue |
| **Skeletal muscle fiber (myocyte)** | Contractile muscle | Skeletal muscle |
| **Syncytiotrophoblast** | Nutrient exchange & hormone production | Placenta |
| **Schwann cell (some types)** | Myelination of peripheral nerves | Peripheral nervous system |

These cells arise either by fusion of multiple precursor cells or by failure of cytokinesis during cell division.
